C0796.title: Microsoft Discovers Shai-Hulud 2.0 Cloud-Native Supply Chain Attack
C0796.summary: Microsoft's security team discovered and analyzed the Shai-Hulud 2.0 supply chain attack, one of the most significant intrusions observed in the cloud-native ecosystem in recent years. Attackers compromised supply chain links, posing a serious threat to cloud environments. Microsoft has released detailed guidance on detection, investigation, and defense.
